news.title: AMD, Micron and Nvidia extend losses as chip stocks get clobbered
news.summary: Semiconductor stocks fell on Tuesday, extending a rout in chipmakers after another weak session on Wall Street. Semiconductor companies have been hit hard in recent months.

news.title: The future of Wall Street is here as startups and brokers build AI agents to trade 24/7
news.summary: Brokerages, startups and even retail investors are building AI agents. They can help oversee portfolios and automate investing tasks once handled by humans.

news.title: Visa is cutting 7% of employees in efficiency push as AI reshapes work
news.summary: Visa plans to cut about 7% of its workforce, or roughly 2,600 employees. CEO Ryan McInerney seeks to streamline the payments giant.

news.title: Trump: New tariffs 'doing the same thing' as the ones struck down by Supreme Court
news.summary: Trump dismissed fears that his tariffs could hurt the economy. affordability concerns have become a key issue of the upcoming midterm elections. Trump: "I don't think it's going to hurt us. I think it will help us"

news.title: Apple plans to lease iPhones for $17.99 a month through partnership with Klarna
news.summary: Apple is announcing an iPhone lease option weeks after raising iPad and Mac prices due to the global memory shortage. Apple is announcing a lease option for the iPhone 5, 5S and 5C.

news.title: Tech fund manager says the market is misreading Alphabet’s second-quarter earnings
news.summary: Catalyst Funds’ chief investment officer says investors should focus more on earnings growth. Investors should focus less on capital expenditures, he says.

news.title: PayPal delivers an earnings beat — and suggests it’s not against a merger deal
news.summary: CEO: "If we see levers or a path that we believe would create superior value for our shareholders than executing our current strategy, we would, of course, carefully consider"

news.title: Micron’s stock sinks toward worst monthly drop in 11 years as China fears escalate
news.summary: Investors are worried about China’s domestic supply of chips and manufacturing tools, analysts noted. China is the world's largest producer of semiconductors.
